payload.summary: On Call: edit, verify and 'Mark all as still correct' show on other accounts' shared rows, and the server refuses them
payload.detail: GET /api/on-call/entries returns every account's shared rows but OnCallEntry has no owner field, so on-call-section-page.tsx offers edit/verify on all rows to any signed-in reader. Verify/PATCH filter on owner_id and 404; bulk verify stops at the first foreign row. Fix: return an is-yours flag from the API and gate the controls on it. No test covers a second account.
payload.source: On Call + CME audit 2026-09-24 (code read + demo-mode screenshots, branch claude/on-call-cme-audit-gltczi)
